facts.fact: The record states that Loi n°22.002 of 11 January 2022, regulating electronic transactions, is the operative Central African law on the subject, listed by ARCEP's law index and cited as existing in the government's PGNSP legal-reform terms of reference; no text of the law was captured.
facts.system: Loi n°22.002 régissant les transactions électroniques
